observations: Photo 0 shows a single headlight assembly with a clear lens and multiple bulb housings.
The headlight has a black plastic housing with visible mounting points and a side reflector with an amber turn signal section.
The lens is reflective and shows some smudges and fingerprints.
The item is placed on a tiled floor with a patterned design.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI JARDON OYIGA' overlaid on the image.
No visible branding, model tags, or part numbers are readable on the headlight itself.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers in photo 0 to confirm it is for an Acura MDX 2018. The seller's text alone is not proof.

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit an Acura MDX 2018 or may be for a different model/year.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight's mounting points, part number, or a photo of the vehicle it was removed from, or a photo of the original part number label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic headlight assembly, not as an Acura MDX 2018 fitment

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., broken bulbs, cracked lens, or internal wiring issues).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bulb housings, lens for cracks, and internal wiring or connectors.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown functionality

risks.risk: The headlight may be a counterfeit or non-OEM part.
risks.proof: A photo of the part number label or a comparison with an OEM headlight from an Acura MDX 2018.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or aftermarket part, not OEM

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or battery compartment showing the model and year.
Clear photo of the headlight's mounting points and any part number label.
Photo of the original part number label or a comparison with an OEM headlight.
Close-up of the bulb housings and lens for damage or cracks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
